FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS

Quick answers to help you get started

CrossFit is a high-intensity fitness program designed to improve your strength, endurance, and overall health. Whether you're a beginner or an experienced athlete, our workouts are scalable to meet you where you are. Our experienced coaches will guide you through proper technique and help you progress at your own pace.

Not at all. All levels are welcome. Anyone can do CrossFit, and our Fundamentals program is designed for beginners. It teaches the basic movements before you join regular classes. Our STRIVE classes have no barbells or high-skill gymnastics and are completely scalable.

Your first class is a complimentary intro session where you'll meet our coaches, learn the basic movements, and get a feel for our community. Arrive 5 to 10 minutes early, wear workout gear, and bring a water bottle. Class workouts include a Base option for every movement. Don't worry about being perfect. We'll guide you through everything.

We have CROSSFIT + STRIVE memberships, STRIVE ONLY memberships (STRIVE HIIT, STRIVE Strength & Conditioning, and STRIVE HYROX), and CrossFit Fundamentals. Plans are monthly and cancel anytime. CROSSFIT + STRIVE memberships range from $149/month for 2 classes per week to $249/month for unlimited. STRIVE ONLY memberships range from $125/month for 2 classes per week to $175/month for unlimited. CrossFit Fundamentals is $99/month. Drop-in classes are $30 each. See the full pricing page for details.

Yes. Our experienced personal trainers offer one-on-one coaching tailored to your goals, whether you want to compete, lose weight, build strength, or improve athletic performance. Sessions are $99 each and include custom programming, nutrition guidance, and individual attention. To get set up, email info@crossfitsouthie.com.

Our staffed hours are Monday to Thursday 5am to 8pm, Friday 5am to 7pm, Saturday 7am to 1pm, and Sunday 9am to 12pm. Unlimited CrossFit members have open gym access during staffed hours. You can add 24-hour access for a $10/month add-on, which lets you use the gym during non-staffed hours. Check the schedule for class times, which vary throughout the day.

Yes. Drop-ins are $30 each. To reserve and pay, select a CrossFit or Open Gym option on the schedule. Visiting from out of town? We also have a $75 week pass, which you can purchase on our membership page. You can also email info@crossfitsouthie.com and we can adjust the dates to your visit.
